newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania industry slips by 7.3 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Romania industry slips by 7.3 pct in January.

text.p: Romania's industrial output fell by 7.3 percent in January from the previous month, but was 12.3 percent up year on year, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.

Figures were adjusted according to the number of working days, a CNS report showed. It said turnover from industrial activity amounted to 7.2 trillion lei last month, with 19.5 percent of the total exported.

A CNS official said the decline in industry in January had been triggered by a 9.5 percent drop on the previous month in the manufacturing sector. The extractive sector rose by 3.8 percent, while the energy sector was down 0.2 percent, the report said.

Inventories amounted to 4.9 trillion lei in January, or 68.5 percent of the month's output, compared to 67.8 percent in December. Productivity per hour in January slid by 12.4 percent from the previous month, but was 13.4 percent up on January 1996.
Industry employed some 2.2 million people in January, around 18,000 less than at the end of last December.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT JAN 97 DEC 96 JAN 96
